sourceNote: The mesh assets/models/wolf/wolf.glb (assets/models/wolf/README.md), with new quad faces on each arm from the shoulder line to the wrist. tools/blender/wind_arms.py makes these faces. The other faces and wolf.glb stay unchanged.
paintedNote: The weights of the clavicles and the arms are the automatic weights of Blender with the Weight Paint fixes of tools/blender/wind_arms.py. The vertices on the bones of paintedLower keep the rule weights, as on the rabbit and the polar bear, because the seated bind of the app depends on them.

armSegments.note: Each upper arm and each forearm has 4 deform segments, and each elbow and wrist a helper bone. The elbow helper is 0.032 units, twice the gap of the rings of the elbow (gap of tools/blender/wind_arms.py), so that the inner elbow does not fold. The app turns the bones from the joints of the pose (poseArm() of src/models/studio-rig.ts).

armSmooth.note: 6 rounds of taubin() smooth the arm tubes of wolf-arms.glb after the weights (arm_smooth() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), at most 0.0144 units. The dense rings on the big flat faces of the mesh made ridges, and the smoothing removes these dents.

name: Wolf

soften.note: The brow ridge of the mesh has a sharp crease over each eye that shades as a dark line, the brow of a sad face. The vertices of these edges move half of the way to the mean of their neighbors in 4 rounds, at most 0.006 u.

proportionsNote: The body below the neck takes 1.2 of the source width and 0.9 of its height, times the body factor 0.9422 on each axis. With keep, the head takes only the factor head (1.235), so that its size is the size of the head of the red fox. The blend zone is the narrow neck. tools/rig/wolf_shape_config.py, wolf_head_config.py, and wolf_size_config.py map the places.

app.note: 1.8659 m for each unit. The standing shoulder joints are at 0.521508 u (0.973079 m), and the standing skull top at 0.8684 u (1.620 m). The reach is 0.4787 m, because the arms take the body factor.

armFactorNote: The factor 1 keeps the arm length, because the rig with arm segments does not stretch the arms. The arms of wolf-arms.glb are 1.178 times longer than the source arms (step_shape() of tools/blender/violin_arms.py), and the arm joints are the joints of the longer arms, so the reach stays app.reach.
legFactorNote: The legs keep the length of the mesh. Do not stretch the legs: change the chair.
jointsNote: The places are in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the tips of the ears, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The bushy tail is a chain of two bones. The joints of the elbow, the wrist, and the paw are the joints of the longer arms of wind_arms.py.

studio.bindArmsNote: The bind forearm and the bind hand turn 45 degrees forward about the bind upper arm from the bind arms of the cat and the dog, and the hand keeps its wrist bend of 25 degrees in the frame of the palm, as on the rhino. The bind elbow sets the zero of the roll of the upper arm, so the rolls of the clarinet stay near 0.
studio.bindSupinationNote: The bind paw of each arm turns about its bind forearm toward supination, the left 66 degrees and the right 57 degrees (paw_supination() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), and the forearm segments share the turn. The bind paw sets the zero of the paw twist, so the paw twists stay small in the clarinet hold.
studio.note: The seated posture of design 5.2: the thigh slopes 25 degrees down and 15 degrees out, and the shin is vertical (tools/rig/leg_turns.py <config> 25 15 0). tailBind turns the tail root 40 degrees below the level over the back of the seat, and the tip hangs down behind the seat, 76 degrees below the level.

haunch.note: The part of the thigh weight that goes to the hips grows from 0 at the lower height to 1 at the upper height, so that the buttocks stay on the hips. This is the rule of the dog, moved with the joints of the wolf.

weights.rigidNote: The corners of each thin face at these points take the mean of their weights (rigid_faces() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), so that the faces do not fold. The points are the middles of slivers of the chest, the shoulders, and the right forearm, in the units of the source.
weights.note: Beyond the plane |x| = armSplit, only the free arm follows the arm bones. Above headFrom (the chin), each vertex except the ears follows the head only. Each ear vertex goes to its ear bone with a ramp over the heights of earBase. The vertices within radius of the line of the tail bones, and behind the plane z = behind, follow the tail bones.

refine.ringsNote: The config has no rings. pnpm rig-mesh wolf --check lists the thin faces near the joints as candidates for a ring (check.thin).

colors.noseShareNote: In the nose box, a face is dark only from the share noseShare, and else takes the mean of its light samples. Thus one large face at the edge of the black nose does not show as a black wedge.

patch.note: Each fur face darker than dark in the box over and beside the eyes, or in its mirror, with a corner below the flat bottom of the ellipse, takes the color of the nearest light fur face. Thus the gray cap ends at a level line over the eyes, with no sad brows, as in wolf-turnaround.png.

smile.note: A thin closed smile under the black nose, with the corners up, as the closed mouth of wolf-turnaround.png. The line takes the dark of the black spots of the paws (color). outward 0.6 keeps the faces that turn to the side out of the line, so the side view shows no dark block.

colors.note: A face is dark when at least eyeShare of its samples have a linear luminance below dark. The limit 0.02 keeps the dark gray fur out of the dark faces. A dark face in the eye box is an eye, and a dark face in the nose box is the nose. The config has no tone rule: the texture colors match wolf-turnaround.png.

chair.note: The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail. The half width holds the haunch. The chair takes the body factor 0.9422. The values of front and back are the values of the dog.

sit.note: The values of the panda, with root of the dog. most 0.09 puts the haunch on the seat with no fold. With carryTail, each tail vertex moves down by the mean drop of the root, by its share on the tail bones, so that the tail keeps its form.
